input.summary:
Surulere Chill Store, Beverages & Snacks shelf, audit confidence 0.94 (trustworthy).

Findings: 3 of 4 planogram SKUs are at expected facings (Gala Sausage Roll 3/3, Beloxxi Cream Crackers 3/3, McVitie's Digestive 250g 4/4). Cabin Biscuit 200g is stocked out on shelf: 0 observed against 3 expected, 1 minimum. Compliance 75%, planogram share 100%, no unknown products.

Action taken: no reorder. Inventory shows Cabin Biscuit 200g at 20 units on hand against a reorder point of 6 — well above the threshold — so this is a shelf-refill problem, not a supply problem. The other three SKUs are also comfortably above their reorder points (15, 12 and 13 units vs reorder point 6), so no order lines were created for them either.

Notified the manager by WhatsApp to have staff face up at least 9 units of Cabin Biscuit 200g from back stock to restore the 3 facings.

No telemetry was available and no equipment fault was indicated, so no technician was dispatched. Only one SKU is stocked out and confidence is high, so no escalation is required.
